{"text":"ItemID: NA; Title: Gorilla Super Glue Gel, 20 Gram, Clear, (Pack of 10); ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Adhesives fit my repair interests, but ten tubes exceed my likely needs right now.
ItemID: NA; Title: Gorilla All Weather Outdoor Waterproof Duct Tape, UV and Temperature Resistant, 1.88" x 25 yd, Black, (Pack of 2); ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: I would choose this for outdoor repairs; I have used Gorilla tape, and weather resistance sounds useful.
ItemID: NA; Title: J-B Weld Original Epoxy, Steel Reinforced Epoxy, High Strength - 2 Pack, Dark Grey (8265S-2); ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: I would try this for durable repairs involving metal, given my past purchases of clamps and repair adhesive.
ItemID: NA; Title: Homax 33873211143 Steel Wool, 12 pad, Assorted Grades, Rhodes American; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I do not have a current cleaning or surface-finishing task that calls for steel wool.
ItemID: NA; Title: Bolt Dropper 1/2" Stainless Flat Finish Washer, 1-1/4" Outside Diameter - 18-8 (304) Stainless Steel, Highly Corrosion-Resistant and Rustproof - Convenient for Any Project Needs (50 Pack); ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I buy hardware for specific jobs, and I have no clear need for this washer size or quantity.
ItemID: NA; Title: Duck Clean Release Blue Painter's Tape 1.5-Inch (1.41-Inch x 60-Yard), 4 Rolls, 240 Total Yards, 240460; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My previous tape purchases were for repairs; I have no painting or masking task in mind.
ItemID: NA; Title: No. 6 x 1/2" Stainless Hex Washer Head Self Drilling Screws, (100 pc), 410 Stainless Steel Self Tapping TEK Screws, No. 2 Point, Plain Finish by Bolt Dropper; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: These require a matching fastening job, and my clamp purchases do not establish a need for these screws.
ItemID: NA; Title: J-B Weld Plastic Bonder Black 25ml Syringe - 2 Pack (50139-2), 25 ml - 2 Pack; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My vinyl adhesive purchase suggests repair needs, but I have no current rigid-plastic repair requiring black bonder.
ItemID: NA; Title: Kuject 120PCS Solder Seal Wire Connectors, Self-Solder Heat Shrink Butt Connector Solder Sleeve Waterproof Insulated Electrical Butt Splice Wire Terminals for Marine Automotive Boat Truck Wire Joint; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: I would choose these for sealed wire repairs; they serve a different connection need from my existing spade terminals.
ItemID: NA; Title: WD-40 Multi-Use Product with SMART STRAW SPRAYS 2 WAYS, 14.4 OZ [2-Pack]; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: It could be useful for maintenance, but I have no immediate lubrication need that warrants buying two cans."}
